tools.name: plan_app
tools.description: Turn a plain-English app idea into a build plan: matched use case, page sections, features, a suggested data model, integrations, honest limits, a refined build prompt and a link that opens the GYSM builder with that prompt. Free and instant: it makes no AI call, creates nothing and changes nothing.

tools.name: plan_online_store
tools.description: Plan a small online store: page sections, product features, checkout options (Stripe Payment Links and/or thirdweb card-or-crypto checkout, both set up in the seller's own accounts), a compliance checklist, a launch checklist, honest limits and a link that opens the GYSM builder with a ready-made pr

tools.name: list_use_cases
tools.description: List the kinds of sites and apps GYSM plans well (online store, restaurant, coaching, portfolio, event page, nonprofit, booking, SaaS and more) with an example prompt and a page for each. Read-only.

tools.name: compare_ai_app_builders
tools.description: Sourced comparison of GYSM against Lovable, Bolt, v0, Base44 and Replit: pricing and allowances as listed on each product's own pricing page on the stated check date, plus what GYSM does and does not do. Facts may have changed since the check date, so confirm on the source pages. Read-only.

tools.name: get_build_link
tools.description: Return a link that opens the GYSM builder with a prompt already filled in. The user signs in and presses build themselves. Creates nothing and spends nothing.

tools.name: get_gysm_plans
tools.description: List the plans GYSM sells today with price, billing interval and what's included. Read-only; buying happens with subscribe_to_gysm, which returns a Stripe link the person pays on.

tools.name: find_stores
tools.description: Search the online shops and businesses built on GYSM (products, appointments, services). Returns each live store's name, description and address. Read-only.

tools.name: get_store
tools.description: Read one GYSM store's catalogue: products with prices and stock, bookable services, shipping options and whether it is taking orders. Read-only.

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Create a secure Stripe checkout link for products from one GYSM store. Only call it after the shopper has confirmed the items and quantities. The shopper opens the link and pays on Stripe's page; nothing is charged by this tool. Prices come from the store, not from the request.
